text:
ops_alex: FYI team — brief status broadcast for a customer-impacting issue in us-west-2. We're observing widespread cache miss amplification causing adapter 5xx and p99 spikes.

statusbot: Incident INC-2026-383 created: Hosted KV cache amplification (us-west-2). Status: investigating. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-383

sre_jamie: Noted pattern: synchronized cold-prefix loads from several large clients + a small subset of SDK versions issuing concurrent large-batch fetches. eviction_rate and cache_miss_rate both trending up.

infra_oncall: Actions taken: 1) enabled prefix-level request coalescing (kv.coalesce=true) on proxies, 2) scaled cache-proxy-by=+4 nodes, 3) temporarily raised connection limits on proxy pool.

eng_runtime: Rolling config push now to all hosting-usw2 proxies. Commands executed: `kubectl -n hosting-usw2 set env deploy/cache-proxy KV_COALESCE=true && kubectl rollout status deploy/cache-proxy`

eng_runtime: Observing reduced queue lengths at the proxy, but a few hot prefixes still show elevated miss storms.

ops_alex: Added an emergency edge-side defense: X-Client-Batch-Limit enforced to 40 for requests exceeding 1000 tokens, and client SDK versions < 1.4.2 are being temporarily throttled.

product_ops: Preparing a customer note for impacted accounts; delaying public status update until we confirm mitigation effectiveness (~20-30m).

cs_olivia: Proactive outreach started to top 5 customers. Confirmed no persistent data loss; logs indicate transient cache misses only.

sre_jamie: Metrics after mitigation: 5xxs down ~65%, p99 latency down ~55% from peak. Keeping autoscaling on for 45m.

eng_runtime: Adding alert rule: high_concurrent_misses_prefix > 80 -> page SRE and enable coalescing. Will PR rule post-incident.

ops_alex: Root cause (preliminary): client-side synchronized retries + cold prefix population -> thundering herd. Next steps: SDK guidance for jitter, make coalescing default, add prefix-level metrics, and follow-up postmortem.

statusbot: Status updated: Partial recovery. Monitoring. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-383

product_ops: Postmortem owners: jamie (SRE), alex (Ops), sam (SDK). Runbook reference: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-thundering-herd

cs_olivia: I'll keep CS looped for any customer escalations. Updating affected customers in 30m unless rollback needed. :thumbsup:

sre_jamie: Thread open until stable for 1h. If anyone sees regression, reply here and page oncall.
